messages:
camila: Heads-up — PR is green but we should hold merge until an architecture quick-note is attached to the RFC. RFC: https://rfc.redwood.internal/r/1173  PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9821
axel: Copy. I pushed the fixes you flagged in the PR, tests all pass. I can merge tomorrow if arch sign-off arrives.
camila: Can someone from arch do a 2–3 bullet summary of the key risk/safety tradeoffs (latency vs caching, KV eviction behavior) we can paste into the RFC? Product wants that pinned to the PR.
david: I can do a brief. Quick note: 1) kv-cache eviction is LRU-like with per-model shard caps — worst-case cold-starts up to ~120ms on p3s equivalent; 2) batching increases throughput but may exceed 300ms P99 under peak if not using burst capacity; 3) fallback plan: route to smaller-quant model with prefix-caching enabled.
priya: thanks david — can you add that as a short section in the RFC and drop the link here when done? we need something for the release checklist.
david: will add in ~30m. pinging arch-bot to create an RFC anchor comment once it's updated.
arch-bot: Automated note: RFC #1173 updated by david at 2024-11-07T15:42:11Z — added "lite-arch summary" section.
axel: perfect. once that's in, who needs to approve the PR? tagging @camila for release window and @priya for product safety ack.
camila: I'll sign off on release timing (targeting 2024-11-08 09:00 PT) if arch note is included and qa smoke passes.
priya: product ACK pending one question: does the fallback route preserve request-level identity headers for audit? if yes i can ack now.
david: yes — fallback keeps auth/trace headers intact; added a line in the RFC.
priya: 👍 product acked.
axel: two remaining asks: 1) @eng-sre visibility for the canary window (30m) and 2) a short changelog bullet. I've added both to the PR description.
camila: tagging eng-sre in the release thread now. eng-sre: please watch tokens and latency, we'll flip traffic at +10m if all green.
arch-bot: Note: PR #9821 now has arch-lite summary and product ack. Blocking label "needs-arch" removed by david.
axel: thanks everyone — if no objections I'll merge at 08:50 PT and begin canary at 09:00 PT tomorrow.
camila: sounds good. leaving this thread open for one last QA smoke in the morning.
axel: will run smoke at 08:40 PT and post results here.
priya: thanks — i'll stand by for regressions.
camila: :thumbsup:
